title: Accessible Developer Conference Landing & Registration Page
brief: Build a single-page semantic HTML5 conference site featuring a skip link, landmark layout, accessible schedule data table, responsive speaker gallery using <picture>, native <details> FAQ accordion, native <dialog> ticket confirmation, and a validated registration form with JSON-LD Event metadata.

requirements.text: Include a valid HTML5 boilerplate with lang, UTF-8 charset, viewport, Open Graph tags, and JSON-LD Event structured data.
Implement full landmark structure (header, labeled nav, single main, footer) plus a keyboard-visible skip-to-content link.
Build the conference schedule using a semantic <table> with <caption>, <thead>, <tbody>, and <th scope="col|row">.
Display speaker portraits with <picture> (WebP + JPEG fallback), explicit width/height, lazy loading, and descriptive alt text.
Create an exclusive FAQ accordion using native <details name="faq"> and <summary> elements with zero JavaScript.
Build a registration <form> with explicit <label for>, <fieldset>/<legend>, inputmode="numeric", native validation attributes, and a <dialog> confirmation modal.

steps.title: Configure Document Head & SEO
steps.details: Create index.html with <!DOCTYPE html>, metadata, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, and a Schema.org Event JSON-LD block.

steps.title: Build Landmarks & Skip Navigation
steps.details: Add the skip link as the first child of <body>, followed by <header>, labeled <nav>, <main id="main-content">, and <footer>.

steps.title: Author the Schedule Table
steps.details: Structure talks into a <table> with <caption>, time slots using <time datetime="...">, and proper scope attributes.

steps.title: Add Responsive Media & Native FAQ
steps.details: Implement <picture> speaker cards and an exclusive <details name="conf-faq"> accordion.

steps.title: Engineer the Accessible Registration Form
steps.details: Wire <label>, <fieldset>/<legend>, autocomplete tokens, required/pattern constraints, and aria-describedby error text.

steps.title: Add Native <dialog> Confirmation
steps.details: Use <dialog> with showModal() and <form method="dialog"> to confirm registration cleanly on the top layer.
